levels: data/light_abstraction_key.csv; the *_level columns give each value's level
note: clear-sky fit on the edge of its grid (tau 0.32, dz 24000.0)
caveats: NASA POWER all-sky PAR is a satellite product (CERES SYN1deg, 1 degree cell), not a radiometer at the reef.
K490 is the median of the MODIS 4 km pixels in a 1 x 1 degree box around the reference point: a reef in clear water next to a turbid coast reads too murky, and shallow bright bottoms can bias it.
Kd(PAR) from K490 uses the Morel et al. (2007) form, quoted from memory: check it before relying on it.
Moonlight is not here: it stays a labelled model (level 4, astronomy).
